parameters.description:
Relay a push notification through your own PushPlus account by posting a native PushPlus payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`pushplus-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `pushplus` payload that includes your credential field; the gateway forwards it to the upstream, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel relays your own authenticated payload; the `plus` channel is the metered tier.
